model.name: ServiceWorker.flushAndReload
model.description: Inline script in OFFLINE_HTML: async function flushCache() { const keys = await caches.keys(); await Promise.all(keys.map(k => caches.delete(k))); const regs = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations(); await Promise.all(regs.map(r => r.unregister())); await navigator.serviceWorker.register('/sw.js'); location.reload(); }. Red button onclick=flushCache().
